test_title: PYST 60: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On 13 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into five segments. The first segment has no error. Select the option that has the segment with the grammatical error.

Due to the pandemic, / the prices of / medicines increased / every day since / last December.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the tense.
 
• Since the sentence refers to a period starting in the past and continuing to the present, the present perfect tense should be used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "medicines have increased," ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part C** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **C**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Due to the pandemic, the prices of **medicines have increased** every day since last December."*
